# DynamicFieldEffect

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
The time-varying influence of an electric field on neuronal excitability and network synchronization, beyond static field effects. Highlights transient field-driven state transitions, critical for understanding and engineering time-varying topologies in TCC.
